### Pages Router → App Router mapping

| Pages Router | App Router | Key API changes |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` | Merged layout + HTML doc; `Metadata` export replaces `<Head>` |
| `pages/index.js` (SSR) | `app/page.tsx` | `getServerSideProps` → async server component + `headers()`; `<a>` → `<Link>`; `<Head>` → `metadata` export |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (ISR) | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → `fetch` with `next: { revalidate: 60 }` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (ISR) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`; `router.isFallback` → `loading.tsx`; `router.back()` → client `BackButton` component |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` | `useRouter` from `next/router` → `Link` from `next/link` |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` | `getInitialProps` → `useEffect` + `error`/`reset` props (App Router error boundary) |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `req`/`res` → `NextRequest`/`NextResponse`; exported `GET`/`POST` functions |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `req.query` → `await params` (Promise-based params in Next.js 16) |

### TypeScript migration
- All `.js` → `.tsx`/`.ts` with full type annotations
- `components/AppProvider.js` → `components/AppProvider.tsx` (added `'use client'` directive, `ReactNode` type, typed context)
- New `components/BackButton.tsx` client component for navigation
